Title: Sapphire Blossom Coasters — Set of 4
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind set of four resin coasters cast as open five-petal blossoms — soft white centres bleeding out through cornflower blue to a deep sapphire rim, each with a cluster of raw amethyst crystals at its heart.

Title: Abalone Shell Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind freeform resin bowl with a soft wavy rim, finished in shifting iridescent greens and teals veined with gold and lilac — the colours of the inside of an abalone shell. The surface changes as you move around it.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Wisteria Shell Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind freeform resin bowl with a soft wavy rim, in deep wisteria violet shot through with pearl and flashes of green-gold. A companion to the Abalone Shell Bowl, cast from the same mould in a different palette.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Aurora Thinkers — Set of 3
Body (HTML):
A set of three seated “thinker” figures, each on a base of deep jewel-toned glitter — emerald, sapphire and ruby — with upper bodies cast in colour-shifting ghost pigment. Indoors they read as soft smoky teal and violet; catch them in direct sunlight and the whole upper body breaks into opal rainbows. No two viewings look quite the same.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!
